EXPLANATORY

NOTE

Transportation by rope aerially is another type of transportation system like railways, roads, etc. The forestry products are transported by means of carrier/carriers suspended on tensioned steel wire rope/wire ropes supported at intervals to limit sagging and thereby prevent the products from touching the ground except at planned points.

Aerial maintanence,

ropeways are preferred over other modes of transport due to their inexpensiveness modest power demand, ability to negotiate valleys and steep gradients.

in

Aerial ropeways used in for transportation of forestry products, normally are of temporary nature The presence of an aerial ropeway in an area depend upon the life and are therefore transportable. Therefore the motive power used for operating the ropeway of the coupe being served by ropeway. Electrically driven ropeways may be employed is generally either diesel engine or diesel generator. depending upon the availability of electric power in areas of operation of portable ropeways covering In case of electrically driven aerial system being planned to be used, the necessary large number of coupe. information as given in Appendix A shall also be provided by the purchaser to the manufacturer. This part of standard aims at listing the data to be supplied to the manufacturers by intending This standard is being issued in purchaser of an aerial system for transportation of forestry products. six parts which aim at listing the data to be supplied to the manufacturer by the intending purchaser of following types of aerial systems : Part I Part II Transportation Transportation of goods, surface of passenger, surface of passenger, underground of goods, underground

Part III Transportation Part IV Transportation Part V Portable

of forestry
